title: Actual npm widget API/client with a local injected-bridge mock
scope: Client behavior only. No real Workshop, Foundry authentication, browser iframe/postMessage/origin enforcement, or permission checks.
mockPolicy: Only window.__PALANTIR_WIDGET_API__ is replaced; package implementation and its dependency are the published npm artifacts.

results.name: construction neither subscribes nor sends ready automatically
ready announces the wire API version 1.0.0
subscribed host payload is dispatched without value conversion
unknown host message is silently ignored by the client visitor
emitEvent forwards updates but does not synthesize a host acknowledgement
reload and resize are one-way bridge messages
unsubscribe stops delivery and subscribe can restore it
message guards only discriminate type and do not validate payload
defineConfig is an identity function, not a runtime schema validator
untyped callers can forward undeclared event/parameter IDs
generic sendMessage is a pass-through at this public client layer
token provider callback resolves placeholder widgets-auth
